title: a proof is smaller than its set across the octave — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
a proof is smaller than its set across the octave, declared in src/proof/ledgerclaims.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

(List.range' 2 255).all (fun n => rounds 40 n < n)

\forall n \in \{2,\dots,256\},\; \mathrm{rounds}\mathopen{}\left(40,\,n\right) < n

Scope. The declaration is decided over a finite domain by exhaustion. It settles no Clay Millennium Problem and claims no quantum speedup. 0/7.
